description: S9 unit U3 (M7 application/observations.py Collector, orphan_report and status_report, INV-OBSERVATION-001), characterized before the move into observation.application.observations: M7's real FileSpool/SpoolDirectory in a per-case temporary directory, the real validate_observation, a MemoryStore, a fixed ticking clock (one second per read), fixed run ids, host and pid; mirrors tests/test_observations.py and the collector parts of tests/test_observation_review{,2,3,4}.py and tests/test_observation_boundaries.py. Cases: dedup by id and content hash and conflict quarantine with its alert; the acknowledgement only after the sink commit (failed commit, retry, no observer); audit confirmation; sink outage with pending-alert replay after recovery; the outage-bounded spool and lost acknowledgement; reclaim during continuous production and after close; segment 9999->10000; a live writer's truncated tail left alone and a finished run's tail quarantined; a crashed writer collected, reclaimed and pruned; prune=False and a raising prune; pending-only alert replay and a failed replay commit; corrupt, business-message-shape, schema-refused and validator-raising records; batch bounds; constructor refusals; orphan_report over every reservation outcome; status_report with and without an observer over a real and a memory directory; the canary on every surface. Declared nondeterministic fields are normalized inside the driver, not by the mask list: the temporary root (<root>), the file spool's two wall-clock stamps (updated_at/closed_at proven ISO-8601 UTC, reported as <utc-iso>, their bytes taken out of every byte total), mtimes (aged files set to a fixed epoch) and orphan_report's default as_of. No network, container, thread, child process or database
